messages.subject: shinyapps.io hungarian encoding
parts:
Hi,

I have problem with hungarian character encoding. When I run my app locale, there is no problem, but when I upload to shinyapps.io the special hungarian characters displayed in wrong form.
I tried to be set a lot of encoding types with iconv(), but always the same problem. (Windows-1250, latin2 etc.)
e.g. textCorpus = tm_map(textCorpus, content_transformer(function(x) iconv(x, to="ISO-8859-2", sub='byte')), mc.cores=1)

Are there any possibility to display hungarian characters in the shinyapps.io?

Thanks.
